claim_text: Under H1--H5, the projection operator exists and is unique on the admissible domain.
source_anchor: The Projection Operator / Existence and Uniqueness of Projection (thm:projection)
empirical_support_currently_available: Formal proof in source only; no empirical program required for the theorem itself.
falsification_condition: A counterexample satisfying H1--H5 but lacking a unique projection refutes the claim.
review_risk_if_overstated: Low if kept internal to the formal framework; medium if exported as an empirical fact.

claim_text: The induced transition is contractive and yields a unique fixed point and compact global attractor.
source_anchor: The Transition Operator / Contractivity (thm:contraction); Existence of Unique Attractors (thm:fixedpoint, thm:compactness)
empirical_support_currently_available: Formal proof in source only.
falsification_condition: A valid H1--H5 model with non-contractive dynamics or multiple incompatible attractors refutes the claim.
review_risk_if_overstated: Low.

empirical_support_currently_available: Formal proof in source only.
falsification_condition: A collapse map compatible with the core hypotheses would refute the claim.
review_risk_if_overstated: Low.

falsification_condition: The non-claim fails only if the corpus itself starts asserting these excluded claims as established results.
